messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT 6141239876 — autosignal: p99 latency spike on inference streaming endpoints. p99 rose from ~2.4s to ~9.2s. Affected: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/embeddings (tail). Paging oncall-anna. Initial hypothesis: config-store lock contention causing config fetch timeouts, amplifying auth/rate checks. Marking P1.

oncall-anna: On it. pulling runbooks now (inc-runbook-config-store). Quick check: config fetch median ~1.2s, p99 ~6.0s on controlplane calls that the runtime blocks on. Streaming sessions backlog visible in gateway metrics. Will gather traces and attach.

eng-sre-maya: Looking at DB. Observed many "orphan_lock" entries in config_locks table with create_ts ~ 20–40m ago. Connection pool also saturated on leader. Query: ```SELECT lock_id, holder, state, now() - created_at as age FROM config_locks WHERE state != 'released' ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 50;``` shows repeated holders with no active sessions. Suspect failed cleanup after previous leader failover.

eng-ml-jay: Noted increased KV cache miss rate in runtime (prefix cache). Model-serving pods started queueing up because feature-flag fetches blocked the request path; requests waiting on config fetch before model routing. This explains tail spikes and streaming stalls.

prod-tom: Customer impact: majority low-latency degradations but one enterprise client reported streaming disconnects + retries. Frontline shows elevated 502/504 from proxy after 30s. Opening customer incident INC-2026-042 and notifying account team.

support-iris: Contacted affected customers, set status page to "degraded performance" for streaming API. Adding note: retries may be seen; advise clients to implement exponential backoff.

eng-sre-maya: Mitigation plan: 1) clear orphan locks on leader via safe cleanup job, 2) if locks persist, perform rolling restart of config-store leader to force cleanup, 3) temporarily enable fallback routing (route id fb-quant-1) to a smaller quantized model for streaming to reduce pressure. I'll run safe cleanup query first: ```BEGIN; UPDATE config_locks SET state='released', released_by='cleanup-bot' WHERE state='held' AND now() - created_at > interval '15 minutes' AND holder NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions); COMMIT;```

oncall-anna: Executing cleanup now in canary (region us-west-2). Also toggling fallback route to 10% traffic to reduce risk. Will monitor p95/p99.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cleanup-job started against config-store leader-1 (job id: cleanup-433).

eng-ml-jay: Also enabling feature flag roll: `sticky_config_cache=true` for 10% of runtime pods to reduce fetches while we clean locks. This should cut sync hits.

oncall-anna: Cleanup confirmed: ~1.9k orphan rows transitioned to released on leader-1. Rolling restart queued for leader-2 and leader-3 as contingency. Observed p99 drop to ~3.1s after canary cleanup + fallback 10%. Continuing restarts for remaining replicas.

eng-sre-maya: After restarts and cleanup, locks cleared and DB pool usage back to normal. Current metrics: p95 ~0.9s, p99 ~1.6s for affected endpoints. No errors injected; streaming backlog drained.

prod-tom: Drafting customer communication: "We experienced intermittent streaming delays caused by internal config-store lock buildup; mitigation included safe cleanup of stale locks and temporary routing fallbacks. No customer data was lost. We're scheduling a postmortem and longer-term fixes." Will share with accounts after review.

support-iris: Marking incident as mitigated on status page; updating ticket INC-2026-042 with timeline and actions. Scheduling follow-up check-ins with affected customers.

eng-sre-maya: Follow-ups assigned: pg:investigate-orphan-locks (owner: eng-sre-maya), infra:leader-failover-hardening (owner: eng-infra), runtime:cache-backoff-tuning (owner: eng-ml-jay). Will collect audit logs and detailed traces for the PM.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT 6141239876 status -> mitigated (duration ~00:43). Handing off to postmortem queue. Reminder: please file postmortem within 72h and attach runbook updates and the cleanup SQL. :white_check_mark:

oncall-anna: Handoff to eng-sre for postmortem. I'll be available for follow-up but moving to next oncall tasks. :wave:

eng-sre-maya: Acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem and schedule a 1hr blameless review tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Adding tags: inference, config-store, locks, streaming, mitigation.
